surface.label: Support
surface.purpose: Report something broken, ask for something missing, and vote on what the club should build next

systemMessage.planned: The 4IR team has taken this on.

overview.noFeatures: Nobody has asked for anything yet
overview.noneMine: You have not opened any tickets

detail.notFoundHint: This ticket does not exist, or it is a bug belonging to somebody else.

ticket.label: Ticket
ticket.description: Something broken or something missing, with a number, a type and the whole conversation about it

feature.label: Feature
feature.description: What the club is asking for, ordered by how many members want it

queue.label: Queue item
queue.description: Open bugs. The 4IR team sees every one; anybody else sees their own

create.label: Open a ticket
create.description: Report something broken or ask for something missing. Describe it in your own words; the description becomes the first message in the ticket's thread.

findSimilar.label: Find a feature like this
findSimilar.description: Look for features that already ask for this. Use before opening a feature ticket: if one comes back, offer to like it instead of filing a duplicate.

vote.label: Like
vote.description: Add your like to a feature. One person, one like.

unvote.label: Take back a like
unvote.description: Remove your like from a feature.

setStatus.label: Set status
setStatus.description: Move a ticket along. The 4IR team only.
